why: Each row changes step by step. Row 1: the leaf gets thinner until it is a line. Row 2: one more leaf is added each time. Row 3: the simple curve gets more and more curled, so the next one is the most curled hook, option 3. Option 2 is just the first curve again.
trick: In "growing" rows, the missing figure is the next step of the same change, not a figure already used.
